row.sso_plan: Similarweb for Business (custom package or SSO add-on)
row.evidence: Similarweb's SSO article says 'SSO is a premium feature and is only available on certain packages or as an add-on' and offers OIDC sign-in with optional auto-provisioning ('user creation in Similarweb can be done directly through your SSO provider'); no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM: the only IdP automation is OIDC SSO (Okta, Azure/Entra, OneLogin, PingFederate, Auth0 custom apps) with optional just-in-time auto-provisioning of users at sign-in; deactivation is manual by account admins. SSO is a premium feature on custom Business packages or as an add-on (Contact Sales). Self-serve Entrepreneur packages are single-user: Competitive Intelligence $125/mo billed annually ($199 monthly), Competitive Intel & SEO & AEO $333/mo ($399), Competitive Intel, SEO & AEO & Ads $542/mo ($649), each '1 User', so the team plan is the custom Business package. Users can be bulk-invited with a CSV template. The Similarweb API is a data API with no user-management endpoints.

scim.notes: No SCIM documented: support-centre search for 'scim' returns 0 articles; the SSO article's 'Auto-Provisioning' is sign-in based.

user_api.notes: The Similarweb API (developers.similarweb.com) is a traffic/market data API; its index lists no user, seat or account-member endpoints.

okta.notes: Custom OIDC app integration created in Okta per Similarweb's guide; okta.com/integrations/similarweb/ returns 404. Auto-provisioning is JIT at sign-in.

entra.notes: Custom Azure app registration (OIDC); no Microsoft Learn gallery tutorial (similarweb-tutorial 404).

onelogin.notes: Generic OpenId Connect (OIDC) app in OneLogin per Similarweb's guide.
